findings.claim: Fortinet 硬體高度集中台灣代工（歷年約85–95%），並警示中台緊張可能影響台灣製造；ASIC/零件無保證產能或價格的長約，部分零件為單一或有限來源
findings.excerpt: (“Western Digital”), are available from limited or sole sources of supply. We have no long-term contracts related to the manufacturing of our ASICs or other components that guarantee any capacity or pricing terms.

findings.claim: FY2024 10-K 列出代工夥伴（Accton、IBASE、MSI、Senao、Wistron）且其使用台灣與日本的 TSMC 等晶圓廠
findings.excerpt: Our current manufacturing partners include Accton Technology (“Accton”), IBASE Technology, Inc. (“IBASE”), Micro-Star International Co. (“Micro-Star”), Senao Networks, Inc. (“Senao”), Wistron Corporation (“Wistron”), and a number of other manufacturers.

geo_supply_chain.note: 搜尋摘要為轉述、無可逐字複製原文；以 clues 交由程式核 10-K 原文。FY2025 台灣製造占比百分比未確認。「single point of failure」字樣在 10-K 指產品平台風險，非供應鏈。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
